fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the complaint was reported.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {YYYYMMDD} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: COMPLAINANT NAMES
fields.description: Customer's First Name, Middle Name and Surname or Company Name

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: The complainant customer id (Unique identification number issued to customers)

fields.name: ACCOUNT NUMBER
fields.description: The complainant account number (Unique number assigned to accounts by the reporting institution)

fields.name: COMPLAINANT’S PHONE CONTACT DETAILS
fields.description: Complainant's phone contact details such as mobile number, etc

fields.name: COMPLAINANT’S PHYSICAL ADDRESS DETAILS
fields.description: Complainant's physical address details such as address, street name and town.

fields.name: AGENT/OUTLET ID
fields.description: Agent or Outlet id of the agent/outlet complained against (Where the complaint made is about an agent or outlet)

fields.name: NAME OF AGENT/OUTLET COMPLAINED AGAINST
fields.description: Name of Agent or Outlet at which the complain is against

fields.name: NATURE OF COMPLAINT
fields.description: Details on the nature of the complaint:

fields.name: DESCRIPTION OF COMPLAINT
fields.description: Details on the nature of the complaint:
fields.example: Made a cash deposit that has not reflected in the account.

fields.name: DATE OF COMPLAINT
fields.description: The date when the complaint was lodged, in the format {YYYYMMDD} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: STEPS TAKEN (REMEDIAL ACTION)
fields.description: Details of the remedial steps taken
fields.example: Request the agent to give a detailed explanation of the event.

fields.name: DATE OF CLOSURE (IF THE ISSUE IS CLOSED, OTHERWISE LEFT BLANK)
fields.description: The date when the complaint was closed, in the format {YYYYMMDD} as per ISO 8601.
fields.payload_key: DATE OF CLOSURE (IF THE ISSUE IS CLOSED, OTHERWISE LEFT BLANK)
